cover.title: Near miss, no harm. Report it?
cover.kicker: Staying silent is the common mistake.

lines.show: A near miss. No one was hurt.
lines.say: A near miss. No one was hurt. Do you report it?

lines.show: Pause. Report it, or let it go?
lines.say: Pause. Report it, or let it go?

lines.show: Report it. That is exactly why near misses are reported
lines.say: Report it. Near misses are reported precisely because no one was hurt this time.

lines.show: The review looks for system causes, not blame
lines.say: The review looks for system causes, not someone to blame.

lines.show: If harm happens: explain, apologise, say what will change
lines.say: And if harm does happen, explain honestly, apologise, and say what will change.

lines.show: An apology is generally not an admission of liability
lines.say: An apology is generally not an admission of liability.
